summary: Iteration 35 REGRESSION testing after code cleanup (hoisted recharts constants in OverdueEvolutionChart.js + FinanceClientDetail.js, useCallback/useMemo, and os.environ.get with fallback in 9 test files). Backend regression: 13/13 new tests + 43/43 tests from iterations 30/32/33 all PASS. Frontend regression: /finance renders OverdueEvolutionChart with data-testid, all 4 period buttons (7d/30d/90d/YTD) work correctly, aria-pressed toggles correctly, the correct GET /api/finance/overdue-evolution?days=X is fired on each click (7, 90, 201=YTD), FinanceClientDetail opens without React error, and the credit-evolution-card histogram (with hoisted HIST_* constants) renders SVG cleanly on the Informação tab. All 9 modified backend test files load without syntax errors. No functional regressions from the refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (NOT caused by this iteration): FinanceClients.js and FinanceClientDetail.js emit React hydration warnings 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' / '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' triggered by the visual-editor overlay injecting <span data-ve-dynamic style=display:contents> between <tbody> and <tr>. Cosmetic dev-only warnings, not a functional bug, but worth addressing when the visual-editor wrapper is next revisited.

Pre-existing (NOT caused by this iteration): Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount of ResponsiveContainer in OverdueEvolutionChart. This is a known recharts warning during 0-frame mount and disappears once layout resolves; not related to the constants hoist.

OverdueEvolutionChart.js: fetchData(signal) is invoked with AbortController correctly, but note that setLoading(true) still fires on aborted requests (finally block). Not a functional bug (state is set on unmounted-then-remounted component only in dev StrictMode), but could add an `if (!signal?.aborted)` guard before setLoading(false) for cleanliness.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: /finance load, period selector state, API calls per period, client detail load, credit evolution histogram render)
